contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate, possibly of Postumus (260-269), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped and cuirassed right; twin laces at back of crown point more downwards than may be usual; lightly bearded. Obverse inscription: IMP[--]VS AVG. Reverse description: Pax standing left, with either vertical sceptre or leaning on column. Reverse inscription: P[--]. In exergue: M, for…
